prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact for neutral or negative changes, but underestimated large winning tests.
Sign-in hint changes (4 wins) and home wait_info changes (4 wins) can be helpful, though many tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Choose_path copy and choose_path layout changes can be helpful (each having 1 winning test), though other tests showed no clear effect.
Finish copy, home notification, choose_path redesign, and adoption hint changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests with no wins.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, adoption new_flow, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, home new_flow, and single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Safety Persistence Callout: Displays a prominent reassurance hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in prevents pet data loss across device reboots. (why: Support receives multiple emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in reassurance hints have proven successful in past iterations.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Overview Grid Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a visual grid layout with distinct choice cards highlighting quick-start versus custom pet options. (why: Choose path layout improvements have shown positive impact, helping users quickly understand options and reduce initial drop-off.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Waiting Estimate Banner: Adds an estimated time indicator and visual render progress bar on the waiting screen while the desktop pet initializes. (why: Home wait time averages over 200 seconds median; wait_info changes on home have produced 4 past winning tests by reducing user anxiety during long rendering times.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Controls Overview Screen: Inserts a dedicated quick controls reference screen right before completion detailing how to hide, summon, and interact with the pet on the desktop. (why: Support receives inquiries from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet once setup completes.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Multi-Device Sync Guarantee Hint: Adds a clear hint on sign-in clarifying that account sync automatically backs up pet progress to cloud servers. (why: Addressing account persistence concerns directly on sign-in targets the top customer support theme (8 emails regarding missing/reset pets).)
5: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Waiting Companion Flow: Introduces a temporary interactive mini-activity screen during pet generation so users can preview pet behaviors while waiting for render completion. (why: Mean wait time for home generation reaches 2336s; adding interactive waiting screens keeps users engaged during background rendering.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Duration & Mode Guidance Copy: Updates the choose path headline and body text to set clear time expectations for quick adoption versus custom photo studio paths. (why: Clear path duration guidance helps users select the route that matches their available time, reducing early drop-offs.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Status Readiness Notification Banner: Enables an active notification toggle and progress indicator on the waiting screen to alert users when the desktop pet process is ready. (why: Users often minimize the application during long renders; explicit notification prompts prevent abandoned desktop sessions.)
8: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Desktop Controls Redesign: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a split layout featuring interactive control instruction cards. (why: 78.7% finish conversion leaves room for improvement, and support reports reveal user confusion regarding pet controls post-onboarding.)
9: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Data Safety Hint: Adds a hint to the adoption certificate stage reassuring users that pet traits and naming data are automatically saved. (why: The adoption stage suffers from a 70.5% conversion drop-off; reassuring users about saved data reduces friction during trait finalization.)

scores.note: Sign-in hints have strong past performance (4 wins) and address direct support feedback.
Path redesigns have historically underperformed (-1.3% avg) and carry high implementation cost.
Home wait_info changes have 4 past wins and target long median render wait times.
Adding new screens at finish step consistently shows negative lift (-0.7% across 7 tests).
Sign-in hints effectively address top support complaint regarding account data persistence.
New flows carry high effort and evidence for home new_flow shows negligible impact (+0.1%).
Choose_path copy changes have positive past results (+2.9%) with low implementation effort.
Wait_info indicators on home step reliably reduce drop-off during long renders.
Redesigning screens introduces user friction despite support relevance; redesigns lack wins.
Adoption has high drop-off but adoption hints have historically shown negative lift (-1.2%).
